Family owned

Rivo, Rimon & their father.

Rivo’s is a family shop on Mt Pleasant Road — the kind of place where the barbers remember your cut, ask your kid how they like their hair, and take care of the details before you leave the chair.

“Amazing family owned business. I’ve been going to Rivo’s barbershop for years. Through their outstanding hospitality, Rivo, Rimon and their father treat their customers like their own family.”

Jersey Jones · Google review
